Thanks Markus — reviewed the form and the materials Elena attached. Quick summary of proposed lightweight onboarding criteria we can apply for short pilots (internal pilot threshold):

- Pilot value: under $5,000 total
- Required evidence: completed onboarding form, W-9 (or local equivalent), company registration, two reference invoices (previous 12 months)
- Security: completed short security questionnaire (answers reviewed by applied-ml team) — no infra access granted for pilots
- Contracting: sign a short pilot statement of work (SOW) and invoice routing to billing@redwood.com
- Timebox: temporary invoice-only approval valid for 60 days; procurement to collect full PO if relationship continues past pilot or crosses $5k

I've attached a one-page checklist (lightweight_onboard_checklist.xlsx) you can send to them.

If Karthik approves the threshold and legal signs the SOW template, we can give FastVendor the green light. Elena — if this works, please return the checklist + W-9 and I will create the pilot SOW.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Program Manager, GTM Ops
Redwood Inference
